}}'''Darin''' is an [[Aiel]] from the [[Moshaine]] [[Shaido]]. He is a [[Stone Dog]]. His father was [[Maeric]].

== Activities ==
When his clan begin to jump through a [[Gateway]] provided by "[[Sammael|Cadder]]", he holds the rear guard position. The Gateway suddenly snaps shut cutting him off from the rest of his clan.
